toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":72,"actionability":6,"reason":"The brief makes a strong, evidence-based case: the interim figures are extrapolated, have a wide error band and have often failed to hold up at year-end, while the jump in logged incidents is explained by the new incident app, so keeping the 7 December count is a clear, defensible decision; the main weakness is that it gives no plan to Imelda if the rise turns out to be real."}

output.reason: The brief makes a strong, evidence-based case: the interim figures are extrapolated, have a wide error band and have often failed to hold up at year-end, while the jump in logged incidents is explained by the new incident app, so keeping the 7 December count is a clear, defensible decision; the main weakness is that it gives no plan to Imelda if the rise turns out to be real.
